package statistic

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 1 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) GetLearningSessionSummary(ctx context.Context, studentID, analyticsSessionID string) (domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/students/" + url.PathEscape(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) +
		"/learning-sessions/" + url.PathEscape(strings.TrimSpace(analyticsSessionID)) + "/summary")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	}
	response, err := httpClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsNotFound
		}
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, unavailable(fmt.Errorf("unexpected status %s", response.Status))
	}
	var payload struct {
		Summary *domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary `json:"summary"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	if payload.Summary == nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsNotFound
	}
	summary, err := domain.NormalizeLearningAnalyticsSummary(*payload.Summary, studentID, analyticsSessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return summary, nil
}

func (client Client) endpoint(path string) (string, error) {
	baseURL := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("statistic service URL and internal token are required"))
	}
	parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(baseURL + path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("invalid statistic service URL"))
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, target any) error {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("statistic response must contain one JSON value")
	}
	if limited.N == 0 {
		return errors.New("statistic response exceeds size limit")
	}
	return nil
}

func unavailable(cause error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsUnavailable, cause)
}

var _ repository.LearningAnalyticsSummaryReader = Client{}
